## Mapping Decisions

- The source already arrives in Senzing JSON, so the mapping routes values verbatim: no reformatting, recoding or re-casing (verbatim check passes).
- RECORD_TYPE comes from each record's own FEATURES.RECORD_TYPE (type discriminator); names follow the type: person names on PERSON records, NAME_ORG on ORGANIZATION records, both kept on untyped records.
- ACCOUNT_NUMBER is kept as payload, emitted as `DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT_ID`: at the record root, any key ending in a reserved Senzing attribute name (ACCOUNT_NUMBER) is read as an account feature, which the analyzer confirmed. Deposit account numbers are unique per record, and as a matching feature they would link joint owners.
- Business columns (product, ownership type, status, open date, balance, branch, tier) are payload for the customer 360; they are never used for matching and the compliance view never shows balances.
- Feature objects that hold only a usage-type label (2 records with PHONE_TYPE and no number) are dropped.

## Record Corrections

- **Record 3025** — bootcamper decision, 2026-11-14: untyped record carrying NAME_ORG "PRAVENVGUPTA" and NAME_FULL "WONDERLAND". Its account is OWNERSHIP_TYPE Business, it has a tax ID, and CARD_SERVICES 3024 (same tax ID and date) names WONDERLAND as an organization, so the names were treated as swapped. Emitted as RECORD_TYPE ORGANIZATION with NAME_ORG WONDERLAND (PRIMARY) and NAME_ORG PRAVENVGUPTA (AKA). Values moved, not rewritten.

## Quality Notes

- Quality score 73.8 (completeness 66.3, format 89.6, duplicates 0); the bootcamper chose to continue to mapping.
- Email is 58.6% unique: `info@ca-state.gov` is shared by 9 customers.
- Identifiers are sparse (driver's licence 6%, passport 11%, tax ID 8%); dates of birth use four layouts, passed through verbatim.
- `TAX_ID_TYPE` is reported by the analyzer as not in the default configuration (informational).
- 3 disclosed relationships point at keys outside this file (CUSTOMERS 1312, REFERENCE 3048); they are expected to resolve against other sources' anchors at load time.
